summary.text: Myriad Age Building is Wan clan's Immortal Gu House. When Fang clan reaches Wan headquarters, the house and the treasuries are already gone.

claims.text: Fang Gong suggests reviving Wan clan’s first supreme elder. Fang Di Chang rejects it: Fang clan has no revival method, and even success would deepen enmity rather than clear the grudge. Spring Autumn Cicada and high-rank wisdom path methods that could change Wan feelings are also not held. Fang Di Chang concludes they can only continue forward and attack Wan clan headquarters. Fang clan advances underground in an earth path Immortal Gu House. Fang Di Chang then sends Fang Gong to loot Wan resource points with Chicken Dog Coop while the rest return to prepare for war.
When Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang later meet Heavenly Court Gu Immortals Zhou Xiong Xin and Wan Zi Hong, they stay calm because they still have Myriad Age Building.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Myriad Age Building is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment of Wan clan, not a five-region map seat.

In the anti-Fang alliance battle, Myriad Age Building is named Wan clan’s time path Immortal Gu House and firmly holds back Inquiry Dock while Fallen Flower Hall is pressed by Red River Wheel. Fang Di Chang treats that hold-up, with the concealed identity of Tian Da Ji and Red River Wheel’s restraint of Fallen Flower Hall, as proof that Wan clan prepared well.

Fang Gong leaves Inquiry Dock and collides with Myriad Age Building until the whole building almost collapses. Under roof tile breaker, its defensive killer moves fail to hold and it starts to crumble rapidly. It is forced to activate its strongest defensive method, which rapidly extracts Fang Gong’s lifespan; once that method activates, it can only stop after at least two hours. Fang Gong retreats after forcing that method out, surrounding alliance Gu Immortals pull away from the house, and he then charges Red River Wheel.

After other alliance Immortal Gu Houses fall, only Myriad Age Building remains among the anti-Fang alliance army’s Immortal Gu Houses. It is a rank seven Immortal Gu House that can match rank eight, and without it the remaining rank seven elites would be a disorderly mob. Fang Di Chang orders Fang clan’s six Immortal Gu Houses to surround it; Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang retreat inside, and Fang Gong offers surrender terms. A woman’s voice from the house then speaks for Wan clan, and Wan Gu Chou is identified as the peak rank eight who lived for ten thousand years and created Myriad Age Building. Her killer move everlasting sorrow, cultivated through time path and wisdom path, is amplified through the house to a terrifying degree and is judged to already possess the air of pseudo venerable level. Fang clan’s surrounding houses shake; Fang Gong ages by close to one hundred years of lifespan; Fang clan retreats; and under Myriad Age Building’s lead the alliance army gives chase.
Fang Di Chang later argues that if Fang clan had known about Wan Gu Chou, it would not have sent all six Immortal Gu Houses to attack Myriad Age Building, because her killer move had a limited range.
